title: Vedar — Kamchatka travel
description: Travel platform for the Kamchatka Peninsula, Russia: operator tours with live availability, volcano and safety status, weather, stays, gear, transfers and trip plans. Write operations are four human-confirmed requests only (tour selection, booking request for a specific tour and date, stay request, vehicle charter); they send the traveller's name and phone to the platform/operator and require explicit consent (consent:true) confirmed with the person first. No online payment, no auth, rate-limited by IP. Safety data comes from official sources with update times and is not a safety guarantee.

authentication.reason: Public endpoint, no credentials; initialize and tools/list verified without auth.

probe.reason: Unauthenticated initialize returned vedar-mcp 2.5.0; tools/list returned 20 tools; read-only get_tours call returned live tour data with operator names and prices. No booking/stay/charter/lead request was created during verification.
